risk_title: Provider token spend outruns pre-purchased credits
Description: Consumption growth is driven by internal teams with uncapped keys - spend can outrun the credit envelope inside a single quarter.
Mitigation / Action: Per-key budget caps and hard spend stops shipped in July; weekly burn review with finance.

risk_title: Upstream rate limits apply per organisation, not per key
Description: One team's batch job can exhaust the shared quota and throttle every other caller through the gateway.
Mitigation / Action: Automatic failover across three providers plus request shaping at the edge; per-organisation quota dashboards.

risk_title: Prompt logging retains request bodies beyond data residency commitments
Description: Full request and response bodies were retained for 30 days in a single region, which exceeds what customer contracts allow.
Mitigation / Action: Retention cut to 72 hours with field-level redaction; data protection impact assessment updated.

risk_title: Single-region control plane is a single point of failure
Description: Routing, keys and quota state all live in one region - a regional outage takes every tenant offline.
Mitigation / Action: Second region live since September with a tested 11-minute failover.

risk_title: Streaming responses truncate under the new load balancer
Description: Long completions were cut short for six days before detection because buffering defaults changed
raised: Buffering defect fixed and covered by a streaming conformance test in CI.

risk_title: Provider commercial terms worsen at renewal
Description: Two of the three upstream contracts renew in Q1 2027 with volume commitments set before demand grew – raised at the vendor review.
Mitigation / Action: Renewal negotiations opened early with committed-volume pricing benchmarked across three providers.

risk_title: Customer API keys are stored without automatic rotation
Description: Keys are hashed at rest but there is no rotation endpoint, so a leaked key stays valid until someone notices.
Mitigation / Action: Rotation endpoint scoped for Q4; per-key scopes and last-used telemetry already shipped.

risk_title: Upstream model deprecations break pinned model IDs
Description: Customers pin exact model identifiers; a provider retiring two of them in November would break those integrations.
Mitigation / Action: Alias layer maps pinned IDs onto current models; deprecation calendar tracked per provider.

risk_title: Usage metering lags real spend, so chargeback is disputed
Description: Metering trailed provider invoices by up to 36 hours, so per-team cost attribution could not be reconciled.
Mitigation / Action: Metering pipeline moved to 15-minute batches and reconciled against provider invoices monthly.

risk_title: SOC 2 Type II evidence collection behind schedule
Description: Evidence for five of nineteen controls is still collected by hand during the observation window.
Mitigation / Action: Evidence automation in place for fourteen controls; weekly review with the auditor until the window closes.

risk_title: Latency-aware routing degrades quality on long-context requests
Description: Routing  on latency alone sends long-context requests to whichever model answers fastest, not the one that answers best.

risk_title: Contract engineering ramp-down leaves single-owner areas
Description: Billing and two provider adapters have one owner each once Northcape rolls off in October.
